exposure: Antenatally detected early-onset small for gestational age fetuses (estimated fetal weight and/or abdominal circumference <10th percentile at 16+0-31+6 weeks)
outcome: Ministry of Education special needs designation at school entry age
cohort: A cohort of 581 pregnancies with antenatally detected, nonanomalous, early-onset small for gestational age fetuses, compared to 359,602 nonanomalous births in British Columbia, Canada.
finding: Pregnancies with antenatally detected early-onset small for gestational age fetuses had significantly elevated absolute and relative risks for adverse maternal, perinatal, and longer-term child outcomes compared to the general population.
mod_finding: The risk of cesarean section was identified as an elevated adverse maternal outcome for pregnancies with early-onset small for gestational age fetuses.
followup_time: Up to school entry age (several years)
